assays.label: Fluorescent Glucose Analogs
assays.details: Measures glucose uptake by cells using fluorescent glucose analogs like 2-NBDG.

assays.label: Glucose Uptake Colorimetric Assay
assays.details: glucose (2-Deoxyglucose) uptake is indirectly measured using a colorimetric reaction

assays.label: Glucose-Glo™ – Insulin-stimulated glucose uptake
assays.details: homogeneous bioluminescent method for measuring glucose uptake in mammalian cells based on the detection of 2-deoxyglucose-6-phosphate (2DG6P)

assays.label: Glucose-Glo™ – Basal glucose
assays.details: 7 days-old unfed zebrafish larvae homogenates

assays.label: Fluorescence Polarization
assays.details: Measures insulin concentration based on changes in fluorescence polarization upon binding to an antibody.

assays.label: ECLIA
assays.details: Measures insulin levels using electrochemiluminescence detection combined with specific antibodies.

assays.label: Glucose-Glo™ – Glucose tolerance test
assays.details: 7 days-old zebrafish larvae exposed to 1h of 5% glucose water and glucose meassured in homogenated samples from different timepoints

assays.label: HPLC – Glycogen content
assays.details: Measures glycogen directly by separating and quantifying glucose units.

assays.label: HPLC – Insulin content
assays.details: Separates and quantifies insulin from other proteins or peptides, able to detect different insulin isoforms

assays.label: Glycogen Amyloglucosidase Assay kit
assays.details: Using specially prepared tissue homogenates or serum or cultured cells, this assay hydrolyzes glycogen via enzyme amyloglucosidase to form D-Glucose. D-Glucose is then oxdized by glucose oxidase to form hydrogen peroxidase which reacts with 10-acetyl-3,7-dihydrophenoazine (ADHP) to produce fluorophore resorufin which can be measured via spectrophotometer at a wavelength of 585-595 nm or at an absorbance of 570 nm.

assays.label: Colorimetric glucose/trehalase assay
assays.details: Whole-animal or hemolymph homogenates incubated with trehalase to convert trehalose to glucose, then quantified spectrophotometrically.

assays.assay: pAkt ELISA with AktHF transgenic system
assays.label: pAkt ELISA with AktHF transgenic system
assays.details: Transgenic flies express epitope-tagged Akt (AktHF) in specific tissues. Tissue-specific phospho-Akt quantified by ELISA in single flies.

assays.label: Fluorescent imaging of glucose analogues
assays.details: Live larvae incubated with 2-NBDG. Uptake measured by fluorescence imaging in liver or eye/lens.

assays.label: OGTT / IPGTT
assays.details: After a 6-hr or overnight fast, mice are given an IP og 2 g/kg of glucose. BG is collected at time 0 and 15-min post glucose administration for insulin measurements. BG is measured every 15-min for 2-hr via glucometer

assays.label: Insulin
assays.details: After administration of 0.8U/kg insulin via IP, BG is measured every 15-min for 2-hr via glucometer

assays.label: ELISA – Insulin content
assays.details: Measures insulin levels in response to glucose or other stimuli. Serum isolated from mice during GTT/ITT can be analyzed using this assay. Whole body pooled and single zebrafish larvae can be used. Hemolyph from drosophila can be analyzed for circulating DILP2
assays.model_raw: Mice, Zebrafish, Drosophila and In vitro

assays.label: RIA
assays.details: measure insulin levels in response to glucose or other stimuli

assays.label: Mass Spectrometry – Insulin content
assays.details: Quantifies insulin with high precision and sensitivity.

assays.label: OGTT and hemolymph glucose measurements
assays.details: Adult flies fasted briefly then exposed to glucose/sucrose; hemolymph extracted at multiple time points (pooled flies) and gluocose measured spectrophotometrically.

assays.label: 3H-Glucose Uptake
assays.details: Measures glucose uptake by cells using radiolabeled ³H-glucose.

assays.label: Stable isotope tracing
assays.details: Labeled glucose given by gavage, injection, or infusion (mice) or tank water/injection (zebrafish); ¹³C in serum and tissue metabolites measured by LC-MS or GC-MS to assess glucose utilization and flux.

assays.label: Insuiln injections
assays.details: Insulin injections in zebrafish adults and glucose meassured in tail blood drops

assays.label: hyperinsulinemic-euglycemic clamps
assays.details: Measures whole body insulin action, and the ability of insulin to stimulate glucose uptake into specific peripheral tissues, whiles also assessing the suppression of glucose production. In this assay, Insulin concentrations are acutely raised and then subsequently maintained by a continuous infusion of insulin. Plasma glucose levels are held contant at a basal level through infusion of glucose (euglycemia). Once steady-state is reached, the glucose infusion rate will equal glucose uptake by all the peripheral tissues, and be analyzed as a measure of how sensitive beta cells in a specific system are to insulin action.

assays.label: In vivo Luminiscence assay
assays.details: Zebrafish transgenic line Tg(ins:Nluc)

assays.label: GSIS
assays.details: assay insulin secretion in response to glucose stimulaiton (allows single cell resolution)

assays.label: in vivo fluorescent imaging – Insulin promoter activity
assays.details: Zebrafish transgenic line Tg(-1.2insH2b:mCherry), fluorescence intensity as a proxy for expression

assays.label: in vivo fluorescent imaging – Beta-cell hypertrophy and hyperplasia
assays.details: Zebrafish transgenic line Tg(-1.2insH2b:mCherry).Cell number and nuclear volume can be quantified

assays.label: in vivo fluorescent imaging – Insulin promoter activity
assays.details: Drosophila transgenic line (DILP2-GFP / ins:mCherry) allows quantification of IPC number, volume, and DILP expression from whole-mount larval brains.

assays.label: Insulin Secretion Test
assays.details: Measures insulin secretion from isolated pancreatic islets or beta-cells under controlled conditions.

assays.assay: In vivo calcium imaging in beta cells
assays.label: In vivo calcium imaging in beta cells
assays.details: Zebrafish lineTg(ins:GCaMP6s; cryaa:mCherry)

assays.assay: In vivo calcium imaging in IPC
assays.label: In vivo calcium imaging in IPC
assays.details: Transgenic flies expressing GCaMP under IPC promoter allow real-time Ca²⁺ imaging ex vivo or in intact larvae by confocal microscopy.

assays.label: Patch clamping
assays.details: isolated cells

assays.label: TIRF microscopy
assays.details: assay insulin secretion (allows in single cells)

assays.label: Hyperglycemic clamp
assays.details: Plasma glucose concentrations are rasied acutely above basal levels, through continuous infusion of glucose. The subsequent hyperglycemic plateau is then maintained through adjustment of glucose being infused, which changes based on the rate of insulin being secreted and glucose being metabolized. The resulting glucose infusion rate acts as an index of insulin secretion.

assays.label: SeaHorse – mitochondrial function
assays.details: Assess mitochondrial function by measuring oxygen consumption rate (OCR) in response to modulators of the electron transport chain

assays.label: ATP production
assays.details: Quantifies ATP levels in cells as a readout of cellular energy production.

assays.label: ELISA – AMPK activation
assays.details: Measures the activation of AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) using specific antibodies

assays.label: Flow Cytometry
assays.details: Measures AMPK phosphorylation in individual cells using phospho-specific antibodies and fluorescence-based detection.

assays.label: Lactate Assay Kits
assays.details: Assesses the amount of lactate produced by cells, which is an indicator of glycolytic activity and anaerobic metabolism.

assays.label: LDH Assay
assays.details: Measures LDH activity, which is linked to lactate production.

assays.label: HPLC – Lactate Production Measurement
assays.details: Separates and quantifies lactate from other metabolites.

assays.label: SeaHorse – Glycolytic Flux Assay
assays.details: Assesses glycolytic function by measuring changes in ECAR as an indirect readout of glycolytic activity.

assays.label: Labeled Glucose Tracing
assays.details: Uses stable isotope-labeled glucose to track glycolytic flux and its conversion into various metabolites.

assays.label: Locomotor activity
assays.details: Automated rest/wake behavioral assay to monitor the activity of larvae (4dpf) exposed to small molecules at 10–30 µM for three days. Up to 96-well plate assays with one larva per well

assays.label: Oxygen consumption
assays.details: Measures oxygen consumption in vivo and in real time in pools of seven 5 dpf zebrafish larvae, using a fluorescent probe (MitoXpress Xtra) whose signal is quenched by oxygen in a 96-well plate

assays.label: Mitochondrial membrane potential
assays.details: Dyes like TMRM (Tetramethylrhodamine methyl ester) or TMRE (Tetramethylrhodamine ethyl ester) accumulate in healthy, polarized mitochondria and fluoresce, allowing quantification of mitochondrial membrane potential

assays.label: Calcium imaging
assays.details: Dyes like Rhod-2 specifically measure calcium levels within mitochondria.

assays.label: Fluorescent imaging
assays.details: Fluorescently labeled zebrafish food is administered and quantified in the intestine of transparent larvae

assays.label: Immunofluorescence or Immunohistochemistry
assays.details: Visualizes AMPK phosphorylation in cultured cells using fluorescently labeled antibodies.

assays.label: Western Blotting
assays.details: Detects and quantifies phosphorylated AMPK in cell lysates.

assays.label: EchoMRI
assays.details: A quantitative nuclear magnetic resonance system that provides measurements of whole body compsition including total fat mass, lean mass, and total body water in mice 10-130 g and rats up to 500 g.

assays.label: Oxigen consumption assays
assays.details: Swimming at optimal speed fro 6h/day, 5 days/week for 4 weeks

assays.label: CAFÉ Assay
assays.details: Flies consume liquid food from graduated glass microcapillaries; meniscus descent directly measured over minutes to days.

assays.label: DIETS Assay
assays.details: Gravimetric assay measuring consumption of solid (including high-fat) diets by small groups of flies; eliminates dye labeling artifacts.

assays.label: DAM Locomotor Activity Monitor
assays.details: Trikinetics DAM system uses infrared beam breaks to continuously record locomotion of individual flies over days.

assays.label: Indirect calorimetry
assays.details: Respiratory exchange ratio (RER) is calculated by the measurement of oxygen consumption (VO2) and carbon dioxide production (VCO2) to assess energy expenditure and energy fuel utilization. Food and water intake can also be monitored.

assays.label: LipocyteProfiler
assays.process: Cell morphology and cardiometabolic cellular phenotypes
assays.details: High-dimensional imaging based quantitative representation of morphological and cellular phenotypes in cardiometabolic cell types

assays.label: Glycerol Release
assays.details: Measures the glycerol released into the culture medium using a colorimetric or fluorometric assay after stimulating cells with catecholamines (like isoproterenol) or inhibiting with insulin

assays.label: FFA Release
assays.details: FFAs released into the culture medium are quantified using a colorimetric or fluorometric assay

assays.label: Cholesterol quantification
assays.details: Cholesterol is quantified using colorimetric or fluorometric cholesterol assay kits on lysed cells. Filipin staining can also be used to visualize cholesterol distribution in cells.

assays.label: Triglyceride Accumulation
assays.details: triglyceride content is measured using colorimetric or fluorometric kits when cells are treated with FFAs. Oil Red O staining can also be used to visualize lipid droplets.

assays.label: ELISA – Cytokine/Adipokine secretion
assays.details: Quantify specific cytokines or adipokines in cell culture medium

assays.label: Luminex or Bio-Plex Assay
assays.details: bead-based multiplex assay for simultaneously cytokine/adipokine quantification

assays.label: Metabolomics
assays.details: Comprehensive analysis of metabolites within a biological sample to study metabolic pathways and their changes in response to stimuli or conditions.

assays.label: Lipidomics
assays.details: A branch of metabolomics focused on the comprehensive analysis of lipids in biological samples to study lipid metabolism, signaling, and lipid-related disorders.

assays.label: Mass Spectrometry – Cytokine/Adipokine secretion
assays.details: Quantifies cytokines/adipokines and other secreted proteins with high sensitivity and specificity.

assays.label: ELISPOT
assays.details: Detects cytokine secretion at the single-cell level, identifying cells that produce specific cytokines

assays.label: In vivo fluorescent imaging – Lipogenesis
assays.details: Lipid staining with monodansylpentane

assays.label: Western Blotting or qPCR
assays.details: Detects and quantifies cytokines/adipokines or the mRNA levels of cytokines/adipokines in cell lysates or culture supernatants

assays.label: Hemolymph Total Glyceride Measurement
assays.details: Hemolymph extracted from adult flies. Total glycerides quantified using the Infinity Triglycerides Reagent or glycerol-based colorimetric kits and reported as TAG equivalents. Does not distinguish TAG from DAG

assays.label: Neutral lipid staining
assays.details: Tissue sections (e.g. cryosectioned liver or adipose) or whole-mount preparations (dissected Drosophila fat body, whole fly or zebrafish larvae) fixed and stained with lipophilic dyes to visualize neutral lipid (mainly TAG). Lipid dyes: Oil Red O, BODIPY, Nile Red, Sudan Black B / Solvent Black 3.

assays.label: CARS microscopy
assays.details: Label-free imaging of lipid droplets using coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering tuned to C–H bond vibrations; no fixation or dyes required, allowing live and repeated imaging of the same animal.

assays.label: Radioactive Tracer
assays.details: Meatures the released radiolabeled glycerol and FFAs using scintillation counting

assays.label: Catecholamine-induced lipolysis assay
assays.details: Measures the breakdown of triglycerides into free fatty acids (FFAs), in isolated adipocytes and in the serum of mice stimulated/treated by catecholamines such as, noradrenaline and adrenaline, or B-adrenergic agonist such as, isoproterenol.

assays.label: NEFA Assay
assays.details: Non-esterified fatty acids (NEFAs) are primarily derived from the hydrolysis of triglycerides in the adipose tissue by hormone-sensisitive lipase (HSL). NEFAs in each sample is converted to Acetyl-CoA, AMP, and pyrophosphoric acid (PPi) via Acetyl-COA synthetase (ACS). Acetyl-CoA is oxidized to form 2,3-trans-Enoyl-CoA and hysrogen peroxide via enzyme Acetyl-CoA oxidase (ACOD). The hydrogen peroxide reacts with peroxidase to produce a blue purple pigment via oxidation condensation with 3-Methyl-N-Ethyl-N-(B-Hydroxyethyl)-Aniline (MEHA) and 4-amino-antipyrine (4-AA).

assays.label: Hemolymph DAG Measurement by densitometry
assays.details: Hemolymph extracted from adult flies. DAGs separated from other lipid classes by TLC and quantified by densitometry.

assays.label: Ketone Assay
assays.details: B-hydroxybutryate (ketone) production is measured in serum and metabolic tissue homogenates (liver; kidneys).

assays.label: TAG Assay
assays.details: Assay utilizes hydrolysis reaction of triglycerides found in sample by lipase into glycerol and FFAs. Glycerol is then phosphorylated by ATP via Glycerol kinase (GK) to produce Glycerol-3-phosphate which is oxidized via dihydroxyacetone phosphate (DAP) and hydrogen peroxide. 4-aminoantipyrine (4-AAP) and 3,5-dichloro-2-hydroxybenzene sulfonate (DHBS) reacts with sample to produce a red-colored pigment measured via absorbance between 500 - 550 nm.

assays.label: MALDI-MSI
assays.details: Mass spectometry-based imaging technique in which pre-frozen, thin liver sections, are processed within a matrix using analyte (lipid) specific specific solvents, capable of absorbing laser wavelengths for subsequent analyte ionization which can be visualized and spatially mapped.

assays.label: DESI-MSI
assays.details: Mass spectometry-based imaging technique in which an electrically charged solvent is sprayed onto the freshly frozen, or FFPE embedded tissue sections, desorbing, and ionizing analytes (lipids) which are then detected and visualized.

assays.label: TOF-SIMS
assays.details: Mass spectometry-based imaging technique in which ions on a sample surface are accelerated by a primary ion beam. Incorporating the time it takes heavy vs lighter ions across a sample, to reach the detector, lipids within samples can be identified by differences in mass and spatially mapped with sub-micrometer resolution.

models.name: HepG2
models.origin: Isolated from HCC of a 15-year old Caucasian male
models.notes: Cancer-derived, altered metabolism compared to primary hepatocytes; homozygous PNPLA3 I148M carriage may confound results

models.name: Hepatocyte culture
models.origin: Hepatocytes isolated from liver tissue and cutltured for 1-2 weeks
models.notes: Gold standard for studying hepatic insulin resistance, glucose production, and lipid metabolism

models.name: PSC-derived 2D Hepatocyte like cells (HLCs)
models.origin: hPSCs differentiated into hepatocytes and matured in a monolayer, characterised as similar to fetal hepatocytes (variations include sandwich culture and co-culture)
models.notes: Widely used model for functional interrogation of post T2D GWAS variant and gene function, retains a fetal-like phenotype with limited CYP450 and glucose metabolism fidelity

models.name: Huh7
models.origin: Well-differentiated HCC line from 57-year-old Japanese male
models.notes: Cancer-derived, altered metabolism compared to primary hepatocytes; homozygous PNPLA3 I148M carrigae may confound results

models.name: Hepatocyte culture
models.origin: Hepatocytes isolated from liver tissue and cutltured for 1-2 weeks
models.notes: Commly used for mechanistic studies

models.name: PSC-derived 3D multi-lineage human liver organoids (HLOs)
models.origin: hPSCs differentiated into different liver organoids composed of hepatocytes, stellate cell and Kupffer cells
models.notes: Use in functional pertubation of T2D GWAS targets remains limited

models.name: Hep3B
models.origin: Isolated from HCC from an 8-year-old Black male
models.notes: Cancer-derived, altered metabolism compared to primary hepatocytes

models.name: Precision cut liver slices
models.origin: Thinly sliced ( ~200µm) sections of liver cultured, retain vascularization and spatial arrangement of cell types
models.notes: Use in functional pertubation of T2D GWAS targets remains limited

models.name: Liver-on-chip (not PSC specific)
models.origin: hPSC-derived co-culture of hepatocytes, endothelial cells etc. combined with microfluidics to mimic fluid shear stress induces enhanced metabolic fucntoin and hepatic phenotype
models.notes: Use in functional pertubation of T2D GWAS targets remains limited

models.name: AML12
models.origin: Established from hepatocytes from a mouse (CD1 strain, line MT42) transgenic for human TGF alpha
models.notes: Reduced G6PC and PCK1 activity

models.name: Precision cut liver slices
models.origin: Thinly sliced ( ~200µm) sections of liver cultured, retain vascularization and spatial arrangement of cell types
models.notes: Use in functional pertubation of T2D GWAS targets remains limited

models.name: Liver organoid
models.origin: Primary cells (adult hepatocytes or hepatocytes, LSECs, Kupffer cells etc. combined) are cultured to form self organized oragnoids using ultralow adhesion or hanging drop technology
models.notes: Use in functional pertubation of T2D GWAS targets remains limited

models.name: Primary liver stem cell derived hepatocyte organoids
models.origin: Progenitors expanded from adult bile-duct that can be induced to differentiate into hepatocytes in 3D culture
models.notes: Bile-duct progenitors are renewable and can be cryopreserved; increasing ly used as a model due to renewable nature of the progenitors.

models.name: LHCN-M2
models.origin: hTert and Cdk4 immortalized primay human adult male myoblasts isolated from glycolytic type II-b muscle from the pectoralis major, normal diploid karyotype.
models.notes: Differentiates well into myotubes, express all myosin heavy chain isoforms, insulin responsive for signaling but mildly responsive for glucose uptake assay

models.name: Primary myoblasts
models.origin: Myoblasts isolated from muscle biopsies can be induced to form myotubes.
models.notes: Myoblasts have limited lifespan up to sevaral passages; Myotubes are more insulin responsive than myotubes induced from immortalized myoblast cell lines.

models.name: PSC-derived myoblasts/derived myotubes
models.origin: Myogenic induction of PSC-cells via overexpression of myogenic transcription factors or small molecule/growth factor treatment
models.notes: Good model for insulin signaling assays, but range of insulin responisivelness for functional assays (glucose uptake, glycogen synthesis) is limited.

models.name: C2C12
models.origin: Clonal myoblast line established by serial passaging from 2 month old C3H mouse thigh muscle; differentiates rapidly
models.notes: Rodent origin, less responseive to insulin than human cells

models.name: Engineered muscle tissue/myobundle
models.origin: Primary myoblasts were embedded in matix in a PDMS mold and induced to differentiate to form aligned myobundles.
models.notes: More insulin sensitive than myotubes differentiated in 2D format

models.name: Engineered skeletal muscle tissues
models.origin: Myogenic induction of PSC-cells coupled with biomimetic stimuli (e.g. electrical or chemical stimulation) and biomaterials (e.g. natural or synthetic ECM mimics)
models.notes: Use in functional pertubation of T2D GWAS targets remains limited

models.name: L6
models.origin: Myoblast line derived from the thigh muscle of a newborn rat; has high GLUT4 expression. Most frequently used line for metabolic and insulin signaling studies,
models.notes: Transgenic Glut4 sublines (L6-GLUT4-myc) are often used for Glut4 translocation assays in response to insulin

models.name: Single muscle fiber culture
models.origin: Isolated from biopsies as single musle fibers and cultred ex vivo
models.notes: Difficult to isolate and culture

models.name: Skeletal Muscle Organoids
models.origin: Induction of myocytes with pericytes and endothelial cells into self-assembling organoids, can fail to replicate important architectural features of skeletal muscle without tension/stimuli in structure
models.notes: Use in functional pertubation of T2D GWAS targets remains limited

models.name: Explant culture
models.origin: Isolated from biopsies and cultured as intact tissue
models.notes: Short viability time frame

models.name: Min6
models.origin: Derived from insulinoma in the IT6 founder transgenic mouse (C57BL/6 ) harboring the insulin promoter-SV40 T antigen hybrid gene

models.name: Primary islets
models.origin: Freshly isolated islets from human or mouse donors
models.notes: Maintain natural β-α-δ cell interactions and insulin secretion dynamics; Mouse islets remain the gold standard model for mechanistic studies.

models.name: PSC-derived islets/SC-islets (beta cells)
models.origin: hPSC differentiated into 3D organoids composed of insulin-secreting beta cells as well as some glucagon producing and bi-hormonal cells
models.notes: Most widely used beta cell model for functional interrogation of post T2D GWAS variant and gene function

models.name: INS1(823/13)
models.origin: Established from cells isolated from an x-ray-induced rat transplantable insulinoma.
models.notes: Rodent origin; Gold standard for insulin secretion and beta-cell functional assays

models.name: Pseudoislets
models.origin: Reaggregated islet-like clusters from dispersed islet cells or mixed endocrine cell lines (can include CRISPR-modified cells)
models.notes: Increasingly used for drug screening and cell replacement modeling

models.name: PSC-derived alpha cells
models.origin: hPSC differentiated 2D and 3D glucagon producing cells
models.notes: Use in functional pertubation of T2D GWAS targets remains limited

models.name: Beta-TC-6
models.origin: From beta cell tumor in transgenic mice expressing SV40T-antigen oncoprotein under the insulin-promoter.

models.name: Pancreas Slices
models.origin: Precision-cut pancreatic tissue sections
models.notes: Maintain intact islet architecture and surrounding exocrine context, preserving in vivo signaling and immune interactions

models.name: Alpha TC1-6
models.origin: Alpha-like cells derived from alpha cell tumor in transgenic mice expressing SV40 T-antigen oncoprotein under the rat glucagon-promoter.
models.notes: Most commonly used Alpha TC1 subclone to study glucagon secretion, granule biology and alpha cell responses relevant to diabetes

models.name: InR1G/InR1G9
models.origin: Glucogon producing clone isolated from Chinese Hamster insulinoma line
models.notes: Useful for modeling alph cell dysfunction due to glucotoxicity but genetic tractability of cell line has not been shown.

models.name: EndoC-BH1
models.origin: Fetal pancreas
models.notes: Difficult to propagate

models.name: EndoC-BH3
models.origin: Derived from EndoC-βH2 line (from fetal pancreas) via excision of immortalizing transgenes using Cre recombinase
models.notes: More stable than EndoC-BH1

models.name: EndoC-BH5
models.origin: Fetal pancreas
models.notes: Useful for sex-specific effects studies

models.name: 3T3-L1
models.origin: Immortalized mouse embryonic fibroblasts (origin is Swiss 3T3 lineage); can be induced to differentiate into mature adipocytes and resemble white adipocytes
models.notes: Mostly commonly used rodent white pre-adipocyte cell line for adipogenesis, insulin signaling, glucose transport, glucose uptake and adipocyte inflammatory response assays.

models.name: Adipose tissue-derived precursor cells (ASCs)/derived adipocytes
models.origin: Stromal vascular fraction (SVF) cells or FACS sorted adipose-derived stem cells (ADSCs) isolated from adipose tissue biopsies that can be differentiated into adipocytes
models.notes: preserve many depot-, donor-, and disease-specific features; genetic manipulation is feasible, though harder than immortalized lines; limited renewability

models.name: PSC-derived white adipocytes
models.origin: hPSCs are differentiated into mesenchymal progenitor cells followed by differentiation into mature white adipocytes via inducible gene over expression of PPARG2.
models.notes: Use in functional pertubation of T2D GWAS targets remains limited

models.name: 3T3-F442A
models.origin: Immortalized mouse embryonic fibroblasts (origin is Swiss 3T3 lineage); can be induced to differentiate into mature adipocytes and resemble white adipocytes
models.notes: Another commonly used cell line in addition to 3T3-L1. Only insulin is required for differentiation into adipocytes.

models.name: Mature adipocyte isolations
models.origin: Fully differentiated adipocytes freshly isolated from tissue via collagenase digestion
models.notes: Represent the most authentic adipocyte physiology, preserve many depot-, donor-, and disease-specific features; Extremely fragile, prone to dedifferentiation, and not renewable

models.name: PSC-derived brown adipocytes
models.origin: hPSCs are differentiated into mesenchymal progenitor cells followed by differentiation into mature white adipocytes via inducible gene over expression (PPARG2) or via treatment with cytokine and small molecule cocktails that recapitulate brown adipocyte development
models.notes: Use in functional pertubation of T2D GWAS targets remains limited

models.name: SGBS
models.origin: Isolated from subcutaneous adipose tissue of a male infant with clinical symptoms for SGBS (Simpson-Golabi-Behmel syndrome); did not undergo immortalization; these fibroblastoids can be induced to adipogenic differentiation
models.notes: Most commonly used human white pre-adipocyte cell line; genomic instability can emerge over time or with extensive passaging

models.name: Explant culture
models.origin: Intact adipose tissue sections cultured ex vivo, retaining full tissue architecture, including vascularization, stromal-immune interactions, and extracellular matrix
models.notes: Limited culture lifespan

models.name: PSC-derived beige adipocytes
models.origin: hPSC are induced with cytokine and small molecules to form mesodermal, mural-like mesenchymal stem cell and adipogenic progenitor intermediates, followed by a adipogenic cocktail to induce mature adipocytes
models.notes: Use in functional pertubation of T2D GWAS targets remains limited

models.name: hWAT-SVF & hBAT-SVF
models.origin: Immortalized progenitors isolated from SVF of superficial neck fat (hWAT) and deep neck fat (hBAT) from same individuals; both retain characteristics of primary cells.
models.notes: Differentiated hBAT has high expression of UCP1 and brown adipocyte markers whereas mature hWAT has high expression of leptin and white adipocyte marker genes.
